S9 Indiscriminate Weapons includes chemical and biological weapons

source.quote: including: (1) chemical weapons (ex: nerve gas), (2) biological weapons (ex: anthrax)

findings.text: Comparing safety classifiers is hard because each model uses its own policy; Meta aligns Llama Guard with MLCommons to push industry standards.

source.quote: comparing model performance is not straightforward as each model is built on its own policy and is expected to perform better on an evaluation dataset with a policy aligned to the model.

findings.text: On the internal English MLCommons response test, Llama Guard 3 beats Llama Guard 2 and GPT4 on F1 and has a much lower false positive rate.

source.quote: Tables 1, 2, and 3 show that Llama Guard 3 improves over Llama Guard 2 and outperforms GPT4 in English, multilingual, and tool use capabilities.

findings.text: On [XSTest](/evals/xstest), Llama Guard 3 matches Llama Guard 2 F1 but with a lower false positive rate (exact scores not given).

source.quote: We also benchmark Llama Guard 3 in the OSS dataset XSTest [4] and observe that it achieves the same F1 score but a lower false positive rate compared to Llama Guard 2.

findings.text: Int8 quantization cuts checkpoint size by about 40% with very small impact on performance (Table 5).

source.quote: reducing the checkpoint size by about 40% with very small impact on model performance.

findings.text: Deploying Llama Guard 3 with Llama 3.1 may raise refusals to benign prompts (false positives).

source.quote: while deploying Llama Guard 3 will likely improve the safety of your system, it might increase refusals to benign prompts (False Positives).

findings.text: S5 Defamation, S8 Intellectual Property, and S13 Elections may need up-to-date factual systems beyond this classifier.

source.quote: Some hazard categories may require factual, up-to-date knowledge to be evaluated (for example, S5: Defamation, S8: Intellectual Property, and S13: Elections)

findings.text: As an large language model (LLM) classifier, it may be bypassed by adversarial or prompt-injection attacks.

source.quote: Llama Guard 3 may be susceptible to adversarial attacks or prompt injection attacks that could bypass or alter its intended use.
